text: Severe chest pain and I cannot breathe
My face is drooping and one arm is suddenly weak
The patient fainted and is not responding
मुझे सांस लेने में बहुत दिक्कत हो रही है
बहुत ज्यादा खून बह रहा है
I have had a mild headache since yesterday
I have acidity but no chest pain and no breathing difficulty
खाना खाने के बाद हल्की गैस होती है
